snippet.title: Versalis | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Versalis is a fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players. Archetypes and Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3812220/Versalis/
